summary: Enhance your understanding of gender-inclusive social protection with our comprehensive training. Empower communities and promote equality today!
lede: Gender-inclusive social protection applies gender analysis to benefit design, eligibility, delivery channels and grievance systems. For professionals who design, fund, deliver or monitor social protection programmes, it develops practical ways to identify exclusion risks, check coverage and registry data, and shape accessible benefit and payment pathways. Participants also work on grievance and referral flows, and gender-disaggregated indicators and scorecards for monitoring inclusion and reporting progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, fund, deliver, or monitor social protection programmes and need to improve gender inclusion in practical, measurable ways.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of social protection programmes, public policy, development programming, or monitoring and evaluation. Familiarity with basic programme design, stakeholder engagement, and administrative data is helpful; no coding or advanced statistics are required. Participants should bring a laptop for template-based exercises, and experience with Excel or similar spreadsheet tools will support the practical work. Advanced concepts such as intersectionality analysis and gender-responsive budgeting are taught at operational application level, with some tools introduced for conceptual awareness where needed.
